font.reason: Lalezar is a heavy single-weight display face for the slam title; Noto Kufi Arabic is geometric/techno and variable so weight 800 holds. Noise glyphs use Vazirmatn 700 at 0.8x size.

rtlDecisions.why: Reviewer approved; untouched in this fix pass.
Cell width 0.6*FONT, noise glyph 0.8*FONT at weight 700, charset narrowed (no # $ % & and no Persian zero), so nothing overlaps and the live row stays inside the final title width.
Reading order: right to left, bar fills from the right.

lessons: Fixed-cell scramble noise: Latin/symbol glyphs are wider than Persian letters at the same size and the Persian zero renders as a diamond dot; scale noise glyphs to about 0.8x, use narrow glyphs, and drop the zero.
concerns: Registry duration is 66 frames, so stills at later beats and the full video were rendered with --duration 140.
